notes: The title concerns structure at infinity of M_{g,nu}. The page defines a courbe standart over an algebraically closed field: a quasi-projective scheme whose irreducible components have dimension 1 and whose points are smooth or ordinary quadratic singularities, locally in the étale sense like Spec(k[X,Y]/XY) at 0. It states existence and uniqueness of a proper completion hat-X smooth at the boundary, calls it projective, and names the finite set I at infinity and the singular set A; the two-row formula records their descriptions. The last sentence continues beyond this sheet. These are transcribed assertions, not independently verified theorems. The local word division singu-/liers in the right caption is reflowed as singuliers without counting a mathematical discrepancy. C’s unusual repeated closing quotation marks around the singularity phrase are preserved from the ink. H’s top-number note acknowledges the written 1; root reports that H placed this sheet’s title at the end of the preceding file, so the title is a placement discrepancy, not a global omission. All agreed words, formula signs, hats, indices, punctuation and revision scopes were inspected. The two apparent underlines in the body are connected g-descender flourishes. The three colon-like prepositional signs are retained as à at medium confidence after root’s comparison: the body can shrink to a thick stroke/dot below the detached accent. This applies the repeated-letter-shape rule and does not count as a correction to either witness. All three remain in the blind boxes. No independent mathematical check, OCR, external lookup or compilation was performed.

Independent audit: a small un after the line-final à in condition b is present in the ink but absent from both witnesses. Its possible cancellation is recorded in place; the literal sequence before next-line la courbe is not repaired. The canceled word after I est now retains contenu/courbe alternatives. The whole two-row display agrees. Title B01 has an oval body below the accent; in B11/B12/B13 that body is reduced to a thick point or short stroke. Their repeated prepositional à reading is retained at medium confidence under the local shape habit, not from a change to the formula. This is a reading decision, not an independent theorem check.
